scripts.ci: pnpm run validate:repo && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run audit
scripts.test: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck
